# standard-cluster

CRDs, an issuer, trust, in-cluster DNS, a gateway and a secret generator.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tls | boolean | `true` | Whether the gateway terminates TLS. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| zone | [DNS_ZONE](../signatures/DNS_ZONE.md) | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |

## Requires, optionally

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| edge | [CLUSTER_EDGE](../signatures/CLUSTER_EDGE.md) | Where a cluster's gateway is dialled from the host running the lab. |
| labCa | [LAB_CA](../signatures/LAB_CA.md) | The lab's own root: where its certificate and key are on the host, and where it lands in a cluster. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| exposure | [HOST_EXPOSURE](../signatures/HOST_EXPOSURE.md) | The hostnames a cluster serves through the lab's edge, and where to dial them. |
| gateway | [API_GATEWAY](../signatures/API_GATEWAY.md) | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| gatewayApi | [GATEWAY_API](../signatures/GATEWAY_API.md) | The Gateway API CRDs are registered, so Gateway and route kinds have types. |
| generation | [SECRET_GENERATION](../signatures/SECRET_GENERATION.md) | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |
| issuance | [X509_ISSUANCE](../signatures/X509_ISSUANCE.md) | Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs. |
| trust | [TRUST_BUNDLE](../signatures/TRUST_BUNDLE.md) | A CA bundle distributed into namespaces, for workloads that verify the lab's own certificates. |
| webhook | [X509_WEBHOOK](../signatures/X509_WEBHOOK.md) | The certificate controller's admission webhook is serving, so its CRs are accepted. |

## Operator commands

| command | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `<lab>-ops gateway platform-gateway-controller-listeners` | Show every listener the Gateway declares and its programmed status |

## Lint checks

| check | scope | what it asserts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gateway/gateway/route-hostname-in-zone | per-cluster | Every route asks for a hostname some Gateway in this cluster can serve |
| gateway/gateway/route-listener-exists | per-cluster | Every HTTPRoute and TLSRoute attaches to a listener some Gateway declares |

## Verify checks

| check |
| --- |
| cert-manager/issuers/issuers-ready |
| gateway/gateway/gateways-programmed |
